title: Assemble the 771-compound dataset
action: Extract the list of 771 organic compounds and their experimental enthalpies of formation from the Supporting Information (Table S1). Generate initial 3D molecular geometries from the provided structures (names, SMILES) using a cheminformatics tool.

title: B3LYP/6-31G(d,p) DFT calculations
action: For every compound, perform geometry optimisation, harmonic vibrational frequency analysis, and single-point energy calculation at the B3LYP/6-31G(d,p) level with an open-source quantum chemistry package. Convert the results to raw standard enthalpies of formation via the atomisation energy scheme using the NIST-JANAF atomic enthalpies (C 171.3, H 52.1, O 59.6, N 113.0, S 66.2, F 19.0, Cl 29.0, Br 26.7 kcal/mol). Retain the computed zero-point energies (ZPE).

title: Compute molecular descriptors
action: From the optimised geometries and ZPEs, calculate the 47 descriptors: atom counts (C, H, O, N, S, F, Cl, Br), bond-type counts (C=C, N-H, O-H, C-O, C=N, N=N, S=O, NO₂), ring descriptors (number of 3- and 4-membered rings, rings with size >4, aromatic rings), lone-pair counts on N and S, unpaired electrons, radical-environment descriptors (H atoms on radical, heavy atoms on radical, radical on a double/triple bond), and ZPE.

title: Correlation-based descriptor reduction
action: Compute the Pearson correlation matrix for the 47 descriptors. Remove any descriptor pair whose absolute correlation exceeds 0.90, keeping one descriptor from each such pair. Retain the remaining set of descriptors.

title: Simulated annealing feature selection
action: Implement a Metropolis Monte Carlo simulated annealing algorithm that searches subsets of the reduced descriptor set, using the leave-one-out cross-validated squared correlation coefficient q² as the fitness function. Select an optimal subset of exactly 17 descriptors. Write the abbreviations of the selected descriptors, one per line, to the output file.
description: List of the 17 molecular descriptors chosen by the simulated annealing procedure.
output_schema: A plain text file with exactly 17 lines; each line is one descriptor abbreviation (e.g., N_C, N_OH, ZPE).

title: Ordinary least-squares model fitting
action: Using the 17 selected descriptors and the raw DFT enthalpies, fit the calibration equation Δ_f H_ls⁰ = Δ_f H_DFT⁰ + A + Σ c_i x_i to the full dataset via ordinary least-squares regression. Write the constant term A and a dictionary of descriptor coefficients to the output file.
description: Fitted regression coefficients and constant term of the calibration model.
output_schema: A JSON object with keys: "constant_A" (number, kcal/mol) and "coefficients" (object mapping each of the 17 descriptor abbreviations to its regression coefficient; ZPE coefficient is dimensionless, all others are in kcal/mol).

title: Model performance evaluation
action: Apply the fitted calibration model to all 771 compounds. Compute (a) the MAE of the raw B3LYP enthalpies versus experimental values, (b) the MAE of the calibrated enthalpies, (c) the squared correlation coefficient r² between calibrated and experimental values, and (d) the leave-one-out cross-validated q². Write these four numbers to the output file.
description: Key accuracy metrics of the calibration model.
output_schema: A JSON object with numeric fields: "mae_before_calibration" (kcal/mol), "mae_after_calibration" (kcal/mol), "r_squared" (dimensionless), "q_squared" (dimensionless).
